appStoreReviewDetail.notes: Review path: No account or sample login is required. Create or open a Markdown file, then use Shift-Command-O to open a folder. Use the File Tree, Outline, and Search sidebars; open the Command Palette with Shift-Command-P; switch themes; export PDF or HTML from the File menu. The App Store build has direct-download updates and telemetry disabled.
